name: Kudos Cards
description: The team thanks each other: appreciation for the whole team and for individual people. It is short and warm and builds good relationships.

columns.name: Kudos for the team
columns.prompt: What did we do well together that you appreciate?

columns.name: Kudos for a person
columns.prompt: Who helped you and what did they do?

mood.tired: Appreciation is easy to write and lifts the mood.
mood.tense: Positive words help calm the room.

checkInQuestion: Who helped you recently, and what did they do?
facilitationTips: Give an example of good kudos: name the person and say what they did.
Make sure everyone gets at least one kudo so nobody is left out.
Read the cards aloud slowly and let the receiver just say thank you.
